archetypes.name: dyn-tier-a-report
archetypes.rationale: Tier A report status backfill now controls user-visible fallback decisions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the /design Tier A reporter changes around file_tier_a_after_compose. Verify that every helper, dedup, filing, and normalization failure leaves a useful STALL_RECOVERY_REPORT_STATUS and fallback reason without overriding an existing successful compose status. Pay special attention to issue-input versus chat-print behavior and repeated retry calls. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
